articles.title: Meet Dave Brat, the US ambassador who ‘can speak Trump’ in Canberra - Politico
articles.description: Once an insurgent rabble-rouser in Congress, Brat is now a Trump world insider sent to Australia as tariffs and Pacific tensions test the relationship.
articles.content: A longtime economist and academic, Brat is an avowed free trade advocate, which could quell some nerves on the ground. But Brat has also defended the Trump administrations tariff regime as a kind of … [+2038 chars]
